title: Tier assignment broken — assignTier never called from Change Tier button
note: useTrainerActions.ts:102 declares assignTier mutation but it is never invoked. Change Tier opens the profile edit form which has no tier field.

title: Availability upsert silently resets blocked/timeoff slots to 'available'
note: TrainerAvailabilityEditor omits kind field from slot payload; server default is 'available'. Every save destroys manual blocked/timeoff slots.

title: Assign Branch button is a no-op — branch cannot be changed from the UI
note: onEdit() opens the edit dialog which hides email+scope fields in edit mode (TrainerFormDialog.tsx:158). Trainer cannot be reassigned to a different branch.

title: weeklyStatsBatch requires user_management:approve — staff see '…' for all session counts
note: RBAC gate is too strict for the stats endpoint; staff cannot see trainer session counts even though they can access the trainers tab.

title: Intake Availability feature completely absent from refactored tab
note: CoachIntakeEditor, CoachIntakeClaimDialog, and coachIntake API queries all exist but were not included in the new TrainerAvailabilityTab. Entire intake scheduling feature dropped in refactor.

title: TrainerAvailabilitySheet is read-only — schedule cannot be edited from the tab
note: Hub doc described sheet as an editor. Current sheet has no mutations, no inputs, no save button. trainerAvailability.upsert/create/update/delete API procedures exist but have no UI entry point.

title: Trainer role self-filter relies on unsafe MemberWithId cast
note: member.id not in official UserContextResponse type. If absent at runtime, isTrainerRole=true but callerMemberId=null, causing trainer to see all rows.

title: Missing-rate-categories banner shows raw UUIDs and is never dismissible
note: Banner renders c.categoryId (UUID) not a human-readable name (line 126). No dismiss handler; banner persists for the full page session.

title: Duplicate tier ranks silently allowed — ambiguous ordering
note: rankIdx is a plain index, not uniqueIndex. No service-level uniqueness check in createTrainerTier.
